source: 别着急，咱们一步一步来。
intent: Reassure someone; take it one step at a time. No urgency, no literal walking.

source: 这事儿八字还没一撇呢。
intent: It is too early to say; nothing is settled yet. Avoid literal Chinese character references.
Ask someone not to stand the speaker up or bail. No birds.

source: 我也不是非得今天拿到，明天也行。
intent: Getting it tomorrow is acceptable. Preserve the negation and flexibility.

source: 他可能只是没看到消息，别想太多。
intent: He may simply have missed the message. Preserve uncertainty and reassurance.

source: 这个价格有点离谱，我们再看看吧。
intent: The price is unreasonable; suggest looking around. Conversational and mildly critical.

source: 这正是他想要的，他求之不得，马上答应去安排。
intent: He welcomes the opportunity and agrees immediately. 求之不得 conveys eagerness or could not ask for anything better, not a failed search.

source: 他让服务员通知一声，老板见有了巴结的机会，立刻答应帮忙。
intent: Narration: he asks the waiter to pass word along; the boss sees a chance to curry favor and agrees. Preserve subjects and do not turn the narration into instructions to the listener.
